scope: Theory paragraphs 10–19: definitions, named theorems with proofs, key tasks, embedded worked problems, explicit proof prompts, geometric examples and mathematical remarks. Photographs and decorative context are not separate tasks.
sourceReading: All theoretical pages in the listed ranges were read as actual PDF page images; OCR was used only as an aid.
notes: Existing reviewed overview cards were read and mapped, never modified.
New concrete models illustrate named configurations; general proofs state and use the general hypotheses.
§16 strict general definition of a geometric body is explicitly outside this school text; the lesson preserves its intuitive scope.
§15 existence of triangulation for an arbitrary nonconvex polygon is explicitly not proved in the textbook; the lesson labels that limitation.
§19 full three-dimensional similarity theory is deferred in the textbook; the apothem proof uses only similarity of plane triangles.
